intro.title: Thumb under
intro.text: A scale has 8 notes but you have 5 fingers. In C major the right thumb tucks under finger 3 to land on F, then the hand carries on: 1 2 3 1 2 3 4 5.

intro.title: Three scales
intro.text: C major (bars 1–4), G major with F♯ (5–8), F major with B♭ (9–12). In F major the thumb goes under finger 4: 1 2 3 4 1 2 3 4.
